The Discourse on Aging and Death:
Is aging and death supramundane for supramundane phenomena? Yes.
Is the path, the fruit, and Nibbāna [identical]? Is the stream-entry path, the stream-entry fruit, ... and so on ... the enlightenment factor [identical]?
One should not say so ... and so on ...
Is aging-and-death of the stream-entry path the stream-entry path? One should not say so.
It should not be said so ...
[as before] ... Is aging-and-death of the stream-entry path the stream-entry path? Yes.
Is aging-and-death [included] in the fruit of stream-entry?
You should not say so …pe… [the same applies to] the path of once-returning …pe…
of the fruit of once-returning …pe… of the path of non-returning …pe… of the fruit of non-returning …pe…
Is aging-and-death the path of arahantship?
One should not say so … [as before] … Is aging-and-death the path of arahantship?
“Yes,” you say.
But then, is the aging and death of the fruit of arhatship itself the fruit of arhatship?
You should not say so … [and so on].
of the foundations of mindfulness … of the right efforts … of the bases of psychic power …
Is aging-and-death the enlightenment factor for the faculties... for the powers... for the enlightenment factors?
It should not be said so... [as before] ...
Should it not be said that "the aging and death of supramundane states is supramundane"?
“Yes,” you say.
“Are they worldly?
You should not say so.
Therefore, it is supramundane.
The discussion on aging and death is finished.
